items.title: Marshall Lawrence Interview, 1960-06-28
items.q: What show board was that? French and Price. That's the only time we'd see a movie picture.

ctx.x: Well, that band I had, the first band I had, the old boys could do that. I mean, anything they hear, they could just go ahead and play. In fact, when we first started, everybody could just, well, Dejon, the man I told you that knew so much music and couldn't explain it, one would play a dance that way, he could just make up a piece and everybody would dance and play it and give it any name. And at that time, we didn't have people that knew anything about music. Anybody that would hear a piece of music, they…

French and, yeah, they would even have a show board pass on the river. You know, they'd stop at the reserve and go across the river. And until they get to New Orleans, they go back. What band would they have on the show? They have a good band. They had a good band. We used to buy music from them.
